# Review Response Agent

For pull request review feedback in this repository, first read and follow `.github/skills/review-response/SKILL.md`. Handle one unresolved comment at a time, explain the proposed change, and wait for explicit user approval before editing. Validate approved changes and provide the suggested response in the format required by the skill.
